findings.current: It was an area permitted only to Team Leader Choi, Butler Kim, Song Song, and Im Kkeokjeong.
findings.defect: The access list omits Taekyung, contradicting both his immediately following statement that the room is for founding members “including me” and the active continuity.
findings.rationale: Taekyung is explicitly one of the room’s authorized users and is training the listed members in the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique.
findings.replacement: It was an area permitted only to Team Leader Choi, Butler Kim, Song Song, Im Kkeokjeong, and me.

findings.current: The Peace Guild expands beyond its original Guild House, buying surrounding properties and constructing a larger facility. Magic Johnson discusses the Guild’s growing influence, gives Taekyung a chip for Team Leader Choi, and confirms that a secured training room is reserved for Taekyung and selected founding members learning the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique.
findings.defect: The summary drops the deliberate unresolved hook in which seeing Im Kkeokjeong’s desperate training prompts Taekyung to consider beginning an unspecified plan soon.
findings.rationale: Taekyung’s thought—“Should I start that soon…?”—is an intentional open hook. Recording it without identifying the plan preserves both the ambiguity and the chapter’s forward continuity.
findings.replacement: The Peace Guild expands beyond its original Guild House, buying surrounding properties and constructing a larger facility. Seeing Im Kkeokjeong train with desperate persistence prompts Taekyung to consider beginning an unspecified plan soon. Magic Johnson discusses the Guild’s growing influence, gives Taekyung a chip for Team Leader Choi, and confirms that a secured training room is reserved for Taekyung and selected founding members learning the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique.

findings.current: The cheerful, playful Magic Johnson of usual was nowhere to be seen.
findings.defect: “Magic Johnson of usual” is an unnatural English construction that breaks the polished contemporary narrative voice.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the contrast in his demeanor while using natural English word order.
findings.replacement: The usual cheerful, playful Magic Johnson was nowhere to be seen.
findings.source: Chapter 560, Magic Johnson’s warning to Team Leader Choi

findings.current: People whose paths happened to cross with mine.
findings.defect: The idiom is malformed; paths cross one another rather than “cross with” one another.
findings.rationale: This restores the standard idiom without changing Choi’s restrained description of the relationships.
findings.replacement: People whose paths happened to cross mine.
findings.source: Chapter 560, Team Leader Choi describing prospective allies

findings.current: At the roar of the powerful mutated individual said to be born only once in a million chances, more than a thousand orcs let out shrieks and struck their weapons together.
findings.defect: “Born only once in a million chances” is an awkward collocation and reads like untranslated source syntax.
findings.rationale: “Appear only once in a million cases” naturally preserves the stated rarity without adding a specific reproductive mechanism.
findings.replacement: At the roar of the powerful mutated individual said to appear only once in a million cases, more than a thousand orcs let out shrieks and struck their weapons together.

summary: One internal access-list contradiction and one dropped unresolved hook require correction. Three isolated phrases also disrupt the otherwise consistent contemporary English voice.
